headline: Hatirjheel shooting: Top-listed criminal injured in gun attack
summary: Yeasin Khan, alias Palash, was rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital after being shot by unidentified assailants near Rampura bridge.
details: Unidentified assailants shot a listed top criminal in Dhaka’s Hatirjheel area this afternoon. The victim, Yeasin Khan alias Palash, also known as "Kailla Palash", was rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital with bullet wounds.
According to Md Asaduzzaman, officer-in-charge of Hatirjheel Police Station, the shooting occurred around 1:45 pm near Ekramunnesa Girls' High School, located near the Rampura bridge.
Police stated that Palash is a top-listed criminal with multiple cases filed against him, including charges of murder.

This incident follows a pattern of attacks on listed criminals in the capital. On November 10 last year, Tarik Saif Mamun was shot dead in Sutrapur, and Khandokar Noyeem Ahmed Titon was killed in the New Market area on April 28 this year.
caption:
A top-listed criminal was shot in broad daylight in Dhaka's Hatirjheel area today.

Unidentified assailants shot a listed top criminal in Dhaka’s Hatirjheel area this afternoon. The victim, Yeasin Khan alias Palash, also known as "Kailla Palash", was rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital with bullet wounds.

According to Md Asaduzzaman, officer-in-charge of Hatirjheel Police Station, the shooting occurred around 1:45 pm near Ekramunnesa Girls' High School, located near the Rampura bridge.

Police stated that Palash is a top-listed criminal with multiple cases filed against him, including charges of murder.

This incident follows a pattern of attacks on listed criminals in the capital. On November 10 last year, Tarik Saif Mamun was shot dead in Sutrapur, and Khandokar Noyeem Ahmed Titon was killed in the New Market area on April 28 this year.

headline_marked: Market reality: [[Prices of pulses and sugar rise]] despite budget relief
headline: Market reality: Prices of pulses and sugar rise despite budget relief
summary: Consumers face higher costs for essential commodities as market prices diverge from government budget expectations.
details: Despite messages of relief in the national budget, the reality in the local markets is different. Prices of essential commodities, specifically pulses and sugar, have been on the rise.
Consumers are reporting a disconnect between official budget announcements and the actual cost of goods at retail shops.
The increase in prices for these staples is adding pressure to the daily expenses of common people.
Market analysts suggest that supply chain issues or speculative hoarding may be contributing to the price hikes despite government intentions.
caption:
Budget relief or market reality? Prices of pulses and sugar are climbing despite government promises.

Despite messages of relief in the national budget, the reality in the local markets is different. Prices of essential commodities, specifically pulses and sugar, have been on the rise.

Consumers are reporting a disconnect between official budget announcements and the actual cost of goods at retail shops.

The increase in prices for these staples is adding pressure to the daily expenses of common people.

Market analysts suggest that supply chain issues or speculative hoarding may be contributing to the price hikes despite government intentions.

#Bangladesh #MarketPrices #Inflation #EssentialCommodities #Economy

Source: Somoy News
